name: Natsu no Osananajimi to, Fuyu no Kanojo
original_name: 夏の幼馴染と、冬のカノジョ
source:
This is Nephrite’s first title. The town of Nagashimo only experiences two distinct seasons due to its topography, with only short periods separating summer and winter. Seiji returned to his hometown at the beginning of summer after 10 years away and was happy that nothing appeared to have changed. Together with his lively osananajimi Karin, fellow proud transfer student Mitsu, onee-san-type cousin Yurari, complete-changed friend Atsu and imouto Yume, they founded the animation club to help the school with events.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Nephrite的第一个头衔。由于地形的原因，长下町只经历两个不同的季节，夏季和冬季的间隔时间很短。离开十年后，清二在初夏回到了家乡，他很高兴看到一切似乎都没有改变。他们与活泼的osananajimi Karin、骄傲的转校生Mitsu、姐姐类型的表弟Yurari、彻底改变的朋友Atsu和imouto Yume一起创立了动画俱乐部来帮助学校举办活动。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
